en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a rocky coastal village with traditional wooden houses scattered among low hills. In the foreground are a tiled‑roof cottage and shrubs; further down a small pier with boats and a boathouse extends into a sheltered bay. More houses dot the rocky shoreline and background hills. The caption text is printed along the bottom left and a small logo with a number appears at the bottom right.
